row.evidence: Leah (formerly ContractPodAi) publishes no pricing, only a demo request, and its trust portal says only that it 'supports single sign-on (SSO) integration through multiple identity providers'; no SCIM or user-provisioning documentation is public.
row.notes: Quote-only: no public plans or prices; buying starts with a demo request. ContractPodAi rebranded to Leah on 5 January 2026 (contractpodai.com redirects to leahai.com); the slug is kept. The trust portal confirms SSO with multiple IdPs, MFA through the customer's IdP and RBAC, but no SCIM, JIT or user-provisioning detail. The integrations page mentions open APIs but no API reference is public, and the customer support portal (support.contractpodai.com, Freshdesk) requires login. No OIN app (searches for contractpod, contractpodai and leah returned nothing) and no Microsoft Learn tutorial. Status unknown, confidence low.
